name: ambient-dim
title: Ambient light dimming
summary: A transit card that is a bright card in normal light and switches to black with white and yellow text when the ambient light sensor reads under 10 lux.
prompt: Make a transit card that switches to a black, high-contrast look when the room is dark.
teaches: Read the ambient light sensor (lux) with lightLevel in an expression or a condition
Override a paint only in low light: conditionalOperations lt lightLevel 10 right after the normal paint
Keep the normal-light colours as the default path, so the card looks right when no sensor is present

Fit a drawing authored at the header size to any box: a variable s = min(componentWidth() / W, componentHeight() / H), a translate by half the extra space and a scale by s about the design's centre; the background drawRect runs before it, to componentWidth() × componentHeight()

snippets.note: the label turns yellow in low light

check.describe: system_variables {26: 300} gives the light blue card; {26: 2} gives a black card with white and yellow text. Resized, the background fills the box and the card scales to fit, centred (bright at 540×180, light level 300).

pitfalls: Write lightLevel (or light()), not lightLevel(): both the Java parser and json2rc reject lightLevel() with "Unknown token in expression", although accelerationX() takes parentheses
With no sensor value the player reads 0 lux, which is "dark": a document checked without system_variables shows the low-light variant

Canvas coordinates are pixels of the box the host gives the document, not of the header: a background drawRect to the literal header size leaves the rest of a bigger box unpainted, and literal positions get cut off in a smaller one
